title: 応用有機化学
subtitle: Advanced Organic Chemistry
keywords: Electronic theory of organic chemistry 2.Reaction Mechanism 3.Reaction Control 4.Local Collaboration
educationalGoal: Electronic theories in organic chemistry can help you understand the reactivity of organic compounds in terms of the electron density distribution of atoms and molecules that occur during reactions using in organic synthesis. The courses introduce you to the foundations of the Electronic theory of organic chemistry.
advice: Course Description and Expectations for Students The course introduces the Electronic theory of organic chemistry with the following topics: - Understanding covalent bond from the viewpoint of electronic theory of organic chemistry - Polarization of organic compounds - Inductive effect, electrometric effect, resonance effects, and hyperconjugation - Substitution reaction of hydrocarbons - Electrophilic and nucleophilic reactions - Addition to carbon-carbon double bonds - Elimination reaction - Rearrangement reaction - Fundamentals of Molecular Orbital theory - Radical reactions
books: 教科書および参考書 Required Materials(textbooks, reference books). Fundamental of Electronic theory of organic chemistry 4th Ed., Minoru Imoto, Tokyo Kagaku Dohjin , in Japanese will be used as a textbook.
requiredKnowledge: All participants should have completed all undergraduate courses of organic chemistry, physical chemistry, and chemical reaction theory with a grade A or better.

activityGoals.body: You should be able to explain the electronic factors that influence organic reactions.
You should be able to design a synthetic scheme for an organic compound using the Electronic theory.
You should be able to explain elimination and addition reaction in terms of the Electronic theory.
You should be able to describe polarization in organic molecules.
